mainEntity.name: Will large bathroom wall tile show every bump or uneven spot?

acceptedAnswer.text:
The finished surface may not be perfectly flat if the wall behind the tile is uneven, flexible, or poorly prepared. Tile can follow the substrate, and large-format pieces make bows, high spots, and lippage more visible.

A professional should check the wall before setting tile and correct unsuitable areas rather than trying to force rigid tile into them. Layout changes, additional preparation, or a different tile size may be more practical than accepting visible irregularities.

Key factors:
- Wall flatness across the full tile span
- Tile length, width, and allowable lippage
- Existing framing or backing movement
- Lighting that may emphasize shadows

Use a straightedge or professional assessment before ordering large tile. Elite Remodeling & Design can consider wall correction, tile format, and layout together during bathroom design development.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Large-format tile makes uneven walls, bows, and lippage more noticeable and needs a flatter, more stable substrate. Check the wall across the full installation area before ordering tile; correcting the substrate or choosing a different format may produce a better result.
